description:
Description

We are looking for a Berlin-based detail-oriented Working Student (all genders) to support our Content Operations team in maintaining and managing digital product content.

In this role, you will help ensure that digital assets and product data are accurately maintained across our systems, enabling smooth campaign launches and consistent product information across markets. You will work with digital experience platforms such as CMS (Content Management Systems) and other content tools, contributing to keeping product and marketing content structured, reliable, and scalable. 

Your work plays a key role in maintaining high data quality and supporting efficient content operations.


What you´ll do

In this role, you will support operational content processes and ensure high-quality product data across systems.

Operational execution

  • Support content maintenance activities across digital platforms such as CMS, PIM, DAM, based on defined briefs
  • Clean, archive, and reorganize assets according to guidelines provided
  • Link assets correctly within the PIM environment after DAM upload
  • Support additional operational content tasks such as migrations, content updates, testing, or data validation activities, bulk updates, and checking that content is published and displayed as per the briefs.


Quality & compliance

  • Follow documented processes and governance rules carefully
  • Maintain tracking documentation (e.g. Excel trackers for updates and changes)
  • Perform peer quality checks before delivering tasks
  • Identify and flag missing information or inconsistencies in briefs

Coordination & reporting

  • Provide updates on task progress
  • Escalate blockers early to help maintain timelines
  • Document recurring issues to support process improvements

 

What success looks like in this role

  • Deliver accurate uploads and content or product data updates
  • Maintain correct linking between DAM and PIM systems with zero critical errors
  • Complete tasks within agreed service-level timelines (SLA)
  • Handle larger batches of tasks reliably without loss of quality
  • Reduce rework through thorough quality checks
  • Proactively identify recurring data inconsistencies or improvement opportunities


What you can offer

  • Must be enrolled as a student in a German university for at least another year.
  • Strong attention to detail, process orientation, and ownership of accurate, high-quality data
  • Basic Excel and structured data skills, with the ability to understand relationships, dependencies, and troubleshoot issues
  • Proactive communication when questions, blockers, or inconsistencies occur
  • Good technical affinity with interest in digital systems, content tools, and AI-supported ways of working
  • Comfortable reading documentation and applying defined guidelines carefully
  • Ability to work independently after onboarding while knowing when to ask for support
  • Above all, curiosity and genuine interest in learning how we work

Nice to have

  • Experience with CMS Tridion, PIM, DAM, or similar systems
  • Experience working with custom digital interfaces or content tools


What we offer

  • Work-Life Wellbeing. At ctrl QS, we value your well-being and encourage our team members to maintain a healthy balance between work and personal. We understand that agency life can be highly dynamic and fast-paced, therefore we utilize a time-tracking tool to ensure you receive appropriate compensation through time off for any extra hours worked. Our company offers a flexible working environment, providing options for both full-time and part-time positions. Additionally, you'll enjoy 28 days of vacation every year, ensuring you have the time to recharge and explore your passions outside of work.
  • Vibrant Office in Central Berlin. Located in the digital heart of central Berlin, our bright office space fosters professional and personal interactions.
  • Continuous Learning and Career Growth. We're dedicated to providing a unique learning environment where you can pursue your career goals. We help you find your place at ctrl QS, with a focus on your development goals. You’ll find fluid career paths with opportunities to specialize or grow laterally. Also, our internal Academy offers a wealth of learning opportunities.
  • Diverse and Supportive Team. Join our team of 190 passionate, committed, and fun people from more than 40 nations. We celebrate diversity and welcome everyone to bring their unique perspectives, challenge conventions, and ignite creativity. Together, we form a multicultural and fun-loving team that thrives on collaboration.
  • People-First Culture. At ctrl QS, we prioritize our people above all else. We strive to cultivate a healthy company culture where everyone feels safe and satisfied. Engage in regular team-building activities, fun sport and health initiatives, monthly team lunches, weekly company breakfasts, and regular team events are all part of the routine. And of course, our famous summer and Christmas parties are not to be missed!

description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

  • Originate, negotiate and close partnerships with airport transfer operators, supported by compelling and tailored commercial propositions

  • Build senior relationships with operators, airports, airport authorities and relevant local partners to unlock market access and growth

  • Coordinate internal teams through contracting, integration, launch and ramp-up

  • Own post-launch commercial performance, identify gaps and drive corrective actions

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid or Europe & Remote


Who you are:

  • You bring 2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or 3-5 years in sales, business development, or a commercial role at a high-growth tech company.

  • You have a track record of taking ownership of a commercial area and growing it: markets deepened, strategies sharpened, results delivered

  • You can navigate product complexity and translate it into a compelling sales narrative; experience as a tech BD or sales engineer with full commercial cycle ownership is a strong signal

  • Experience in a tech company, marketplace, or platform business is a strong advantage; B2B sales experience is a plus

  • A background in consulting, or experience at a high-growth tech platform or fast-scaling startup, tells us a lot about your operating style

  • You are self-driven, independent, and resourceful; you thrive with full ownership and minimal guidance

  • You collaborate well in a matrixed environment and bring positive ambition to teams where others are also running their own markets

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • You are fluent in English (spoken and written); an additional European language, French, German, or others, is a big plus

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.
